title: The Wider Listening Course
summary: A course that widens the sensing ring from a few paces to a whole courtyard and teaches the user to rinse the soul after long use.

title: Handbook of Reading Many at Once
summary: A handbook on holding several separate souls in mind together and guarding the mind against the crowd's noise.

title: The Thread Weaving Method
summary: A method of casting many fine threads of soul and weaving them into one steady cloth of awareness.

title: A Course in Sensing Past Barriers
summary: A course in letting the sensing soul pass through timber and stone and cloth to reach the living souls behind them.

title: The Shielded Mind Manual
summary: A manual on keeping the mind closed to hostile souls while the sensing soul stays open to friendly ones.

title: Method of the Far Lantern
summary: A method of raising a lantern of soul far from the body so that it shows a distant place as if the user stood in it.

title: The Calm Reading Course
summary: A course on reading the deeper feelings under a stranger's face and settling them when they run high.
